senses.gloss: f. (עָרַם) trickery, legal evasion, improper means to avoid a religious duty. Y. Peah V, 19ᵇ bot.; Y. Ned. IV, end, 38ᵈ לא חשו לה׳ the Rabbis did not apprehend an evasion. Ib. V, end, 39ᵇ a donation like that of Beth-Horon (v. Mish.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 5:7">ib. V, 7</cite>) <he>שהיתה בה׳</he> which was made for the sake of circumventing (a vow).
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 4:3">Tosef. B. Mets. IV, 3</cite> <he>הַעֲרָמַת ריבית</he> an evasion of the law of usury; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 62b">B. Mets. 62ᵇ</cite>; Y. ib. V, 10ᵇ top; a. fr.
